summary: A member sits down at a staff desk and discovers the stack of letters from people against the bill.
realLife: Vogelsinger had sorted Kennedy’s mail by position when he started reading the opposition pile.
gates: Constituent letters have been sorted by position.
inGame: needs: a constituent letter's stance on a bill and the office's handling of that letter.

turns.what: The member asks for the letters in delivery order.
turns.pulledBy: The member wants to see what arrived after the broadcast.
turns.writesBack: The reading pile keeps its postmarks in sequence.

turns.what: Staff leave letters asking questions in their own folder.
turns.pulledBy: Those writers asked about a clause without taking a position.
turns.writesBack: The mail tally keeps inquiries separate from support and opposition.
